SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.

2. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.
   C. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   B. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.

4. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

6. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.
   B. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

8. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   D. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   C. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   B. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
